text:
Zara (CS): Quick capture from BeaconRx kickoff 1 they surfaced 4 product asks that are impacting their go/no-go decision: per-route cost visibility in the console, an in-app onboarding checklist with progress, better SSO attribute mapping for SAML, and ability to pin customer-specific prompt templates.
Tom (CS): Raw notes from the call: (1) per-route breakdown by model + tokens (they want to show finance teams), (2) checklist UI with checkpoints + completion % for onboarding leads, (3) SAML attribute mapping UI or mapping guide, (4) prompt template management (team-level pins).
Raj (PM): Thanks. Let's triage with Impact/Effort/RenewalRisk tags. Quick ask: any quotes we can send to eng to justify prioritization? Also need sample billing csvs and SAML assertion examples.
Lydia (Onboarding): BeaconRx said: "Our procurement team won't sign off until they can see per-route spends and confirm SSO maps groups correctly." They also requested the checklist so their clinical champions can track progress without CS.
Hank (Support): SAML issue: we saw a failed mapping on last test (ticket S-4622). I'll attach the assertion and logs to the product ticket. Prompt templates: multiple teams requested pinning to avoid accidental edits.
Zara (CS): CS quick votes: per-route cost = High impact / M effort / RenewalRisk=Y; onboarding checklist = Medium impact / S effort / RenewalRisk=Y; SAML mapping UI = Medium impact / M effort / RenewalRisk=Y; prompt templates = Low impact / S effort / RenewalRisk=N.
Raj (PM): I'll create two tickets: RDW-4801 (billing visibility: per-route + model breakout) and RDW-4802 (onboard checklist + prompt templates). SAML mapping I'll log as RDW-4803 and include Hank's logs.
Zara (CS): Can we get a timeline? BeaconRx is in a 60-day procurement window. If we can commit to a small milestone for billing visibility within 2 sprints it helps renewals.
Raj (PM): Planning a 3-day discovery: I'll validate data availability for per-route cost and sketch UI options. Expect a write-up and mock by Wednesday. If data exists we can aim for a scoped MVP in the next sprint.
Lydia (Onboarding): I'll ask BeaconRx to share a sample billing export and SAML metadata. Also will prototype a simple checklist as a Notion page to see if it reduces questions.
Hank (Support): I'll link S-4622 and add the SAML assertion to RDW-4803 when created.
redwoodbot: Reminder: add product-ticket links and customer reference when assigning owners.
Tom (CS): Action items: 1) Lydia request billing/SAML samples from customer, 2) Raj create tickets + run discovery, 3) Hank attach support logs, 4) Zara flag renewals team.
Zara (CS): Scheduling a 20m sync next Thursday 11:00 to review discovery outcomes and messaging to procurement. :calendar:
Raj (PM): Thanks everyone. Tagging for visibility @Raj @Zara @Lydia.
Tom (CS): Closing loop 1 I'll update the feedback tracker and mark per-route billing + checklist as renewal-risk items. :white_check_mark:
